data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 六周案例研究评测规则、技能、检查等Harness工件的修复是否跨任务持续有效，属评测型RSI工作。

scope_support.object_quote: AI coding agents increasingly work inside a harness: rule files such as AGENTS.md, on-demand skills, runtime hooks and automated checks.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Tools that evolve a harness add lessons faster than they retire them, so they should re-test their rules from time to time and retire the obsolete ones.
scope_support.study_quote: I report a six-week case study of my personal system of record, a plain-markdown repository that three AI agent tools edited daily under one shared rule set.
